description: This Kotlin source file defines data structures and a singleton object for managing tool display configurations in an Android app. It includes serializable data classes for specs and config, a ToolDisplaySummary data class for the display info, and the ToolDisplayRegistry object responsible for loading, caching, and resolving tool display specifications from a JSON asset.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing an action specification within a tool display configuration.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the configuration for a specific tool, including emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable data class encapsulating the entire display configuration, including version, fallback spec, and multiple tools.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a summarized, display-ready view of a tool, including computed properties for display lines.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method to resolve and construct a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, tool name, arguments, and metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Private method to load and cache the configuration JSON from assets.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a tool name by replacing underscores and adjusting case.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes action verb strings by trimming and replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string representing a read operation, including path and optional offset/limit.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts the path detail from arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value from a list of possible keys within JSON arguments.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested JSON value based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a JSON value into a string for display purposes, with summaries and type handling.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces user home directory paths with '~' for cleaner display.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely extract a string from a JsonElement.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely extract a number from a JsonElement.
